entities.title: Stowaway (laumufarþegi)
entities.summary: The one player in a round who is not shown the secret word and tries to pass as someone who knows it. The game is named after them.
notToBeConfusedWith: The accused (Round.accused): the player the vote picked, who may or may not be the stowaway.

entities.title: Topic (efni)
entities.summary: A theme with a grid of 16 words (ord), a difficulty (erfidleiki, 1–3), a child-friendly flag (barnvaent) and a category (flokkur). The field names are Icelandic, as in the word-list data.

entities.title: Secret word (leyniorð)
entities.summary: The one word of the topic's 16 (Round.secret, an index) that every player in the round but the stowaway is shown.

entities.title: Host (stjórnandi)
entities.summary: The player who controls a room (State.hostId): at first whoever started it, later whoever took over after the host had been away.
notToBeConfusedWith: The Cloudflare host that runs the Worker.

entities.title: Room code (leiknúmer)
entities.summary: Five letters from an alphabet without I, O, Q and W that name a room; the link ?r=CODE carries it, and knowing it is all it takes to join.
